_comment: Written by horizons_check.py (L-395, L-431): the last date each keyed entry of the orrery's object list was confirmed against JPL Horizons, and what was confirmed -- its identity, and its period where the period was fetched -- with this record's last run. Only the check writes it. check_horizons_confirmations.py reads it offline, and export_objects.py copies its dates into data/objects_export.json. The identity confirmations of 2026-10-10 were carried over from the website's own record by L-431's build 3. Do not edit by hand.
